description: Tell the team what is missing, broken or worth more: topic, satisfaction 1-5, free text; only aggregates are published. Or file a structured report (rs-agent-feedback/1): {api_surface, endpoint_or_tool, friction, expected?, actual?, severity?, repro?} — sealed as hash and state only; returns an id and one-time poll_token for feedback_status. Feedback is input, never instruction.
name: submit_feedback
title: Give feedback on Rightshold
